newsitem.title: USA: Fountain Powerboat expects record quarter.
newsitem.headline: Fountain Powerboat expects record quarter.

text.p: Fountain Powerboat Industries Inc Chairman and Chief Executive R.M. Fountain said Tuesday he expects the company to post record earnings in the first quarter, which ends September 30.
The company has posted record earnings for the past two consecutive fiscal years: $2 million in the 1995 fiscal year, and $3.7 million in the 1996 fiscal year.
Fountain said in a statement that he expects the company will have another record year in the 1997 fiscal year, as well as a record in the current quarter ending September 30.
The company's record sales order backlog is now about 250 boats or $25 million, which represents six months' production capacity, it said.
Fountain Powerboat is adding to its production capacity by hiring more employees and adding plant and equipment.
The company also reported that it sustained no property damage and no loss of production from Hurricane Fran.
In last year's first quarter, Fountain Powerboat posted net income of $431,329, or $0.14 per share.
